note: Flagged items do not block the merge. Each item states what is unverified, why it matters, and where to check it (official link).

flags.issue: 2020 property tax equals 2019 exactly ($6,565) with no change stated; 2018 also equals 2017 ($6,383).
flags.impact: Possible data-entry copy error or a flat bill; affects the history trend only.
flags.check: Compare with the Santa Clara County annual tax bills for 2018–2020.

flags.issue: Stated % changes differ from recomputed % in the 2nd decimal: A 2019 stated +2.8% vs +2.85%; B 2021 stated −5.9% vs −5.96%; B 2025 stated +5.3% vs +5.36%.
flags.impact: Minor (rounding or a different base). Source of the user's percentages unknown.
flags.check: Re-derive from bills. The recomputed values are kept in data/history_check.json.

flags.issue: Effective rate on assessed value implied by the user's bills is 1.335% (A, 2025) and 2.135% (B, 2025). A 1% base plus voter bonds is the Prop 13 structure; the 2.135% figure is well above typical composite rates.
flags.impact: Drives all property-tax projections. Possibly special assessments or bonds not in the user table.
flags.check: Read the 2025 tax bill line items (base 1%, bonds, special assessments).

flags.issue: The composite Cupertino/Santa Clara tax rate was not extracted from an official source (secondary sites give 1.18%). The user's effective rate is used as a labeled input.
flags.impact: Affects the verified-rate row (left blank) and the property-tax projection.
flags.check: Santa Clara County Controller-Treasurer tax-rate area tables.

flags.issue: Cupertino water is served by three systems (California Water Service NE; San Jose Water SE; City system operated by SJWC in W). The parcel's provider is not confirmed, and Cal Water rates for Cupertino were not found.
flags.impact: Water rate is the user's estimate ($100–150/mo) until the provider is confirmed.
flags.check: City of Cupertino water service-provider map; provider's bill.

flags.issue: CRS confirms inherited assets take a basis equal to fair market value at death. IRS Pub 551 text and the statute itself were not retrieved in full.
flags.impact: Model assumes sale right after death has ~zero taxable gain.
flags.check: IRS Publication 551 (Inherited property); 26 U.S.C. §1014.

flags.issue: Insurance ($1,500/yr for each property) is the user's guess. No verified premium average was found; CDI publishes a comparison tool, not averages.
flags.impact: Small share of carrying costs, but it enters every scenario.
flags.check: CDI Compare Premiums tool; insurer quotes for each address.

flags.issue: Exemption after 2026 is indexed for inflation (CRS); the projected 2040–2050 exemption uses a 2.5% inflation assumption. Pending proposals (CRS summary) are not enacted; individual bill terms were not verified.
flags.impact: Estate-tax projections are assumptions, not law.
flags.check: congress.gov bill texts; IRS annual inflation adjustments (Rev. Proc.) each year.

flags.issue: $1,044,586 applies to transfers from 2/16/2025 through 2/15/2027. It is adjusted every two years; the model holds it constant after 2027.
flags.impact: Higher cap = more tax-protected value for a child who moves in. Verify the adjustment in Feb 2027.
flags.check: BOE Prop 19 page and the February 2027 LTA.

flags.issue: PG&E / CCA residential rates not retrieved. Solar install date unknown (NEM 2.0 vs Net Billing Tariff). The user's $10–20/mo credit and SF $30–70/mo electricity are unverified.
flags.impact: Small net effect; treated as user inputs.
flags.check: Utility rate schedule; solar interconnection agreement; CPUC NBT decision.

flags.issue: No inheritance or estate tax rests on secondary sources, not an official FTB/BOE page. The 1% Mental Health Services Tax above $1M is not confirmed in the retrieved FTB schedule (12.3% top rate is confirmed).
flags.impact: Income-tax assumption in the model uses 12.3% + 3.8% NIIT + (not MHST).
flags.check: FTB Form 540 instructions; BOE estate-tax information page.

flags.issue: If any heir is tax resident outside the US, that country may tax the inheritance. Not researched for this public site; details kept internal by design.
flags.impact: Could change net proceeds for a given heir.
flags.check: Tax authority of the heir's country of residence.

flags.issue: Advice letters 628-A and 629-A give conflicting monthly service charges; the service charge is blank. Volumetric tiers (628-A) are verified.
flags.impact: Small (fixed charge); only relevant if SJW serves the parcel.
flags.check: SJW current tariff Schedule No. 1 (CPUC).

flags.issue: An official foreign tax-authority source for heirs resident outside the US was not retrieved. Values are blank.
flags.impact: Only for a foreign-resident heir (see F-12).
flags.check: That country's official tax authority (kept off the public site by design).

flags.issue: Early counts (Nov 4–5, 2026) show Prop 40 failing; results are preliminary and not certified. Qualification is verified (SOS).
flags.impact: None for these estates: the tax applies only above $1B net worth.
flags.check: California Secretary of State certified results.

flags.issue: 2026 capital-gains rate thresholds from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §4.03 were not extracted (rates 15%/20% are statutory; thresholds blank).
flags.impact: Model uses 20% + 3.8% NIIT as a conservative top rate; exact brackets not used.

flags.issue: Prop 19 treatment for a 3-unit building where one unit is owner-occupied is not confirmed (rental units are reassessed). Rent Board coverage of each unit, and the land/building split for depreciation, are unknown.
flags.impact: Model reassesses the whole building (conservative). A partial exclusion would change the result.
flags.check: SF Assessor Prop 19 office; SF Rent Board unit registration.

flags.issue: SFPUC stormwater and drought-surcharge structure not fully extracted; the user's water figure may or may not include sewer.
flags.impact: Water/sewer totals may be understated.
flags.check: SFPUC Rate Schedules PDF (later chunks) and the property's bill.

flags.issue: At the official W-1B rates, a $330–400/mo water bill implies roughly 26 ccf/month for 3 units (about 19,000 gallons). This is high; it may include sewer, multiple meters, or a leak.
flags.impact: Could overstate water cost.
flags.check: SFPUC bill; meter count and consumption history.

flags.issue: Market values ($3.1M Cupertino, $1.8M SF) are user estimates. No official valuation was obtained; they drive all totals and estate tests.
flags.impact: High. Each 10% change moves projections and the estate headroom.
flags.check: Appraisal or current comparable-sales data at the time of inheritance.

flags.issue: 2026 assessed value ($550,537) is the user's table value (derived at +2%). The 2026 roll itself was not verified.
flags.impact: Used as the Prop 19 base-year starting point.
flags.check: Santa Clara County Assessor 2026 roll (Notice of Assessed Value).

flags.issue: No rent estimate for Property A was supplied, and none was invented. The site shows break-even rent instead.
flags.impact: Living-vs-renting comparison is a break-even, not a verdict.
flags.check: Local rental comparables for a home of this size.

flags.issue: Sale cost (5%), maintenance rates (0.5% Cupertino, 1.0% SF), investment return (4–8%), investment tax drag (15%), 35% rental marginal rate, 80% building share, 25% recapture rate, and 5% SF vacancy are labeled assumptions.
flags.impact: These drive the sell-vs-hold ranking; see the sensitivity table.
flags.check: Owner's own advisor; replace with verified figures when known.

flags.issue: The plan involves inheritance through a trust. Whether trust-held transfers change the Prop 19 analysis (and the timing of change in ownership) was not verified against an official source.
flags.impact: Could change the reassessment date and the qualifying-transfer rules.
flags.check: Estate-planning counsel and the county assessor.

flags.issue: The repository started with only a one-line README. No earlier data, code, or site existed; all files in this session were created here. Other parallel sessions' work could not be reviewed.
flags.impact: None on values; process note.
flags.check: COORDINATION.md task board.
